profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Quickbase
profile.summary: Principal Software Engineer with experience across the stack: microservices, event-driven systems, data pipelines, UI heavy apps, AI agents, and most recently Pave: Quickbase’s agentic AI app builder.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Software engineer working on Cloud based contact center solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-Op
positions.description:
Worked on developing regression testing application for Teradyne's IGXL Maintenance software.
• Worked in C# .Net and VB developing an object oriented Software system for the tool.
• Followed the MVVM design pattern to implement and develop a user friendly and intuitive UI using WPF and XML
• Took the tool through the software development life-cycle, from requirements through to implementation

positions.title: Software Automation Engineer - Co-op
positions.description: Worked on bug fixes, feature implementation and integration tests for Teradyne's IGXL Maintenance software. Desktop application built on top of Teradyne's IG-XL services. C# .NET, WPF (XML), WCF, Visual Studio
